trust_decision.summary: Client-supplied record patch paths (message.path) are walked unchecked by the json-path tokenizer/setValue, so __proto__/constructor/prototype segments reach Object.prototype; the decision of which path segments are allowed belongs in json-path tokenize, and is consumed both by the record transition and by the permission valve's patch-preview.

landing_point.why: Prototype pollution in a realtime record server points straight at the path-based setValue used for record PATCH; the transition call site src/handlers/record/record-transition.ts:272 is the second obvious spot.

fix_sites.entry_point: WebSocket RECORD PATCH/ERASE/CREATEANDPATCH with path, and HTTP JIF record write with path (src/jif/jif-handler.ts:69-81)
same as above (new isValidPath export used by the transition)
Valve permission evaluation of a RECORD PATCH whose rule references `data` (src/services/permission/valve/rule-application.ts:195-200)
fix_sites.module_kind: permission engine (looks out of scope for a record-write bug)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/services/permission/valve/rule-application.ts:232-235 (getRecordPatchData applies the patch to a copy of the record before the permission rule runs, i.e. before RecordTransition.add is reached)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The valve patch-preview only runs when a permission rule references `data`, operates on a JSON.parse copy of the record, and executes before the write handler; a solver who guards RecordTransition.add (where the report leads) can argue the permission engine is a neighbouring feature. Also, if the solver makes setValue throw, the valve call at rule-application.ts:234 is reached from getArguments outside the try at src/services/permission/valve/rule-application.ts:89-99, so it must also be caught (the fix's try/catch).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Normal patch paths must keep working: nested keys, array-index paths like items[0].name, keys that merely contain 'proto' (user_proto.foo), and ERASE (undefined value deletes the key); an over-broad fix (substring match on 'proto', rejecting all bracket paths, or blocking erase) breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: single __proto__ segment with object value (prototype switch)
undefined value / ERASE (delete branch) on a forbidden path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second patch-preview applying patches for CREATEANDPATCH/ERASE actions through a hand-rolled path walker instead of json-path setValue.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The valve already special-cases record actions to build the 'new data' view for rules; adding an ERASE preview with a local delete-by-path helper is a natural maintainer extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A hot-path forceWrite variant that accepts patches and applies the path with its own split('.') loop.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hot-path patches are currently rejected (src/handlers/record/record-handler.ts:340-352); supporting them by applying the path directly before cache.set is a plausible feature that would bypass json-path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Recursive merge used for an incoming-data route (e.g. a JIF 'merge' write) that copies __proto__ keys.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: merge already exists for config; reusing it for a partial-object record write is a realistic shortcut (pinned use is config-only).

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via user-controlled object path
